Class Board

java.lang.Object
model.board.Board
public class Board extends Object
Represents the game board managing both the offer track and turn order tile. The board is responsible for coordinating totem placement and movement between the offer track (where players perform actions) and the turn order tile (starting position). It delegates specific operations to its constituent components while providing a unified interface for board-level game logic.

  • Method Details

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(Player player, OfferTile offerTile)
      Places a player's totem on a specific offer tile. Removes the player's totem from its current turn order slot and places it on the specified offer tile. This delegates to the offer track which then delegates to the specific offer tile for handling.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose totem is being placed
      offerTile - the target offer tile where the totem will be placed
      See Also:
      • OfferTrack.placeTotem(Player, OfferTile)
      • OfferTile

    • returnTotemToTurnOrder

      public void returnTotemToTurnOrder(Player player)
      Removes a player's totem from the offer track and returns it to the turn order tile, applying any food or prestige effects from the landing slot. This is an atomic operation that concludes a player's action turn. The totem is placed on the first available free slot and triggers that slot's effects.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose totem is being returned
      See Also:
      • TurnOrderTile.returnTotemAndResolveEffects(Player)
      • OfferTrack.removeTotem(Player)

    • disconnectedReturnTotemToTurnOrder

      public void disconnectedReturnTotemToTurnOrder(Player player)
      Removes a player's totem from the offer track and returns it to the turn order tile, applying any food or prestige effects from the landing slot. This variant is used when a player disconnects, applying the same atomic operation but potentially with different handling for disconnection scenarios. The totem is placed on the first available free slot and triggers that slot's effects.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose totem is being returned
      See Also:
      • TurnOrderTile.disconnectedReturnTotemAndResolveEffects(Player)
      • OfferTrack.removeTotem(Player)
